import { Aside, CardGrid, LinkCard } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';

```powershell
launcher-toolkit init my-game
cd my-game
launcher-toolkit dev
launcher-toolkit check
launcher-toolkit build
```

The starter is a complete launcher in Preact + htm with plain CSS, no build step, and a Windows CI
workflow. You need no Rust, Node.js, npm, CSS compiler, or separate Studio.

<Aside type="caution" title="Preview limits">
Pack Studio simulates the game update, the anti-cheat status, and the game start, so you can test
every state of your UI. It never installs or starts a game.
</Aside>

The starter is a public download with a [restricted license](/launcher-toolkit/getting-started/starter/#license)
for games integrated with EMAC Anti-Cheat. Keep its license notices.
